name: Shader
signature: public sealed class Shader : Asset, ISerializable

docs.summary: A shader in Graphite's ShaderDef format: its source, the parsed definition, and the Graphite shader materials draw with, which declares the material's properties and keyword axes. A source that fails to parse leaves the shader without a Graphite shader, and its materials draw with the Invalid shader.

The properties a material of this shader has, in declaration order.

The render queue its materials draw in by default, 2500 and up transparent.
Whether the shader has a pass of this type, such as ShadowCaster.

docs.summary: Inlines the includes of a source that are neither Graphite's nor Prowl's library, each once, through `resolve`. Library includes stay for the compiler. An include it cannot find stays as written.
Loads a shader from a ShaderDef file.

Raw source text of a built in shader.
Pulls the declared name out of the `Shader "Some/Path"` line at the top of a shader source, without parsing it. Leading comments and blank lines are skipped. Null when no declaration is found.
